independentAudit.geometry: Python separating-axis test and minimum point-to-edge rectangle distance; stopped targets clamp forecast time to -V/A; circular lateral coordinates use radius 200 m, road clearance [right=8.5344,left=12.192] m; verify sampled recovery dwell against all five tolerances
independentAudit.diagnostic: Replay the two saved failed frames using a temporary copy of solvePredictiveControl with a diagnostic-output assignment only; no optimization or control equations changed. Both return flag -2/nativeStatus 2 at every attempted trust scale and after potential-field restart: adapter maps these to primal infeasibility.
independentAudit.observerScope: Sampled ego published state bounds and the target components selected by auditNrmmTruthEnclosure; not continuous-time containment or an all-component target-model certificate.

scope: Current executable two-stage affine PCBF/CLF and actual NRMM adapter on the nominal bicycle plant with synthetic bounded sensors; one noisy seed. Safety metrics cover executed prefixes through recovery/failure and 31 sampled instants per hold, not motion after missing control or all continuous instants. This does not evaluate the full joint exact-set mathematical controller, parameter-mismatch stress, physical perception, statistical reliability or production real-time guarantees.
retention: Compact numerical results only. Bulk per-frame exports and MAT continuations are temporary and excluded from the source commit. No new standalone narrative report, source snapshots, figures or algorithm changes.
